title: Today's my birthday!
grammar: Verb be: questions with How old; Preposition in for months; Preposition on for dates; Ordinal numbers 1st–31st
vocab_topic: Entertainment events; Months of the year
pair_game: Say a month. Your partner says the next month. Then swap!

grammar_box.title: How old? / in / on
grammar_box.tip: in + month (in July), on + date (on July 3rd) — oy bilan in, sana bilan on

questions: When is your birthday? What month and date is it?
How old are you? How old are your parents?
What do you usually do on your birthday? Do you have a party?
What is your favorite month of the year? Why?
What entertainment events do you enjoy — concerts, movies, or games?
Is there a special event in your city in summer or winter?
When is your favorite holiday? What do you do on that day?
How do people in Uzbekistan celebrate birthdays?
What is the best birthday gift you have ever received?
What event are you looking forward to this year? When is it?
starters: My birthday is in … . It’s on … .
I’m … . My mom is … and my dad is … .
On my birthday I … . I have / don’t have a party.
I enjoy … . I like … very much.
Yes, there is … in … . / No, there isn’t.
My favourite holiday is … . It’s on … . We … .
The best gift is … . It’s from my … .
samples: When is your birthday? What month and date is it?
My birthday is **in** October. It’s **on** October **9th**.
When is your favorite holiday? What do you do on that day?
My favourite holiday is Navruz. It’s **on** March **21st**. We eat sumalak and visit grandma.
How do people in Uzbekistan celebrate birthdays?
We have a party with family. We eat plov and a big cake. Friends bring presents!

game.title: Birthday bingo
game.rules: Ask: “Is your birthday in …?” “How old are you?” Write a name in a box. Get 3 in a row!

mini_talk.title: My birthday
plan: Say your birthday month and date
Say what you do on that day
mini_talk.model: Hi! I’m Madina. I’m **eleven**. My birthday is **in** April. It’s **on** April **15th**. On my birthday, my family has a party. We eat plov and a big chocolate cake. My friends come too. My best present is a pink bike. I love my birthday!

cando: say my birthday with in and on
